name: beapi/elasticpress-french-addon
description: ElasticPress addon that improves Elasticsearch analysis for French content.

setup:wp: wp core is-installed --path=wordpress || wp core install --path=wordpress --url=https://elasticpress-french-addon.ddev.site --title='ElasticPress French Addon' --admin_user=admin --admin_password=admin --admin_email=admin@example.com --skip-email
setup:plugins: wp plugin activate elasticpress elasticpress-french-addon query-monitor debug-bar-elasticpress --path=wordpress

scripts-descriptions.cs: Run PHPCS with the project WordPress coding standards ruleset.
scripts-descriptions.cbf: Auto-fix PHPCS issues with PHPCBF where possible.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run PHPUnit unit tests (no WordPress bootstrap).
scripts-descriptions.setup: Bootstrap WordPress, ElasticPress, and this addon for local DDEV use.
scripts-descriptions.setup:wp: Download and install WordPress into wordpress/ if missing.
scripts-descriptions.setup:plugins: Symlink this addon and activate ElasticPress, Query Monitor, and the debugging addons.
scripts-descriptions.setup:ep: Point ElasticPress at the DDEV Elasticsearch service and run an initial sync.
scripts-descriptions.seed:corpus: Create or update ~1000 corpus posts (traps + bulk) without inline EP sync.
scripts-descriptions.verify:options: Run functional checks for every French Addon admin option.
scripts-descriptions.verify:corpus: Run trap search assertions against ElasticPress (addon profile).
scripts-descriptions.compare:corpus: Purge/reseed corpus, then baseline vs addon verify (2× sync --setup).
